0022600211.text: The Knicks (5-4, third in the Atlantic and fifth in the East) host the Bucks (1-8, 15th in the East) with New York riding a three-game winning streak, while Milwaukee has lost five straight. Josh Hart is listed as day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision for New York. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Knicks won the season series 2-1, including a 127-98 victory in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
